issues: Scrambled/merged list items in Article 1: item 9 and item 10 are combined on one line, breaking the numbering structure.
Scrambled/merged list items in Article 2: list markers 'a.' and 'b.' are merged ('andb.') instead of being separate items.
Scrambled/merged list items in Article 3: list markers 'i.', 'j.', 'k.' are merged onto one line and 'andm.' is merged; list item boundaries not preserved.

Minor meaning drift in Chapter II heading: 'ASAS, PRINSIP, DAN TUJUAN' should be 'PRINCIPLES, PRINCIPLES, AND OBJECTIVES' is awkward/duplicative; should distinguish 'Asas' vs 'Prinsip' (e.g., 'Principles, Guidelines, and Objectives').

Meaning drift in Chapter II heading: "ASAS, PRINSIP, DAN TUJUAN" was translated as "PRINCIPLES, GUIDELINES, AND OBJECTIVES"; "ASAS" should be rendered as "Principles" (or "Fundamental principles"), not "Guidelines".

Minor meaning drift in Article 1(12): "berusaha dan bekerja sendiri" was translated as "work and work independently"; should be "to undertake business/enterprise and work independently" (or equivalent).
Scrambled numbering/list structure in Article 10: paragraph markers (2) and (3) are embedded mid-sentence instead of appearing as separate numbered items, risking downstream boundary splitting.

Minor meaning drift in Article 10(2): "kedayagunaan dan kehasilgunaan" is better rendered as "utility and effectiveness" (or "usability and effectiveness"), not "efficiency and effectiveness". "Efficiency" is not stated in the original.

Scrambled list/numbering structure: in Article 4(1) and 4(2) the sub-items a–c are run into the preceding sentence instead of appearing as distinct list markers in order, matching the original structure.
Scrambled list/numbering structure: in Article 5 the sub-items a–c are run into the preceding sentence instead of appearing as distinct list markers in order, matching the original structure.

Scrambled/merged list markers in multiple places: lettered items are concatenated (e.g., 'form of:a.', 'andc.', 'andb.', 'andd.', 'andf.', 'andh.') instead of appearing as separate list items in order.

Numbering structure issue: Article 25 paragraph (2) and Article 29 paragraph (6) are merged into the preceding paragraph line instead of being separate numbered items, risking downstream boundary splitting.
Scrambled list structure in Article 21 paragraph (3): item d is merged into item c ("; and d.") and the original has separate items a–d.
Minor meaning/wording drift in Article 21(3) item a: "pengadilan negeri" is more precisely "District Court" (not plural "district courts").
Scrambled list/numbering structure in Article 21 paragraph (3): original has items c and d merged as "dand."; translation splits them into separate c and d items, altering the marker/content mapping.
